verdict.rationale: Composio's docs repeatedly claim access to 1000+ (and elsewhere 1,500+) toolkits/apps via sessions, MCP servers, and CLI, with concrete API examples (Gmail, Slack, GitHub, Notion, Linear, HubSpot, Strava, Instagram) and probes confirming live docs/OpenAPI endpoints. A community report of a 400 error specifically on the Instagram connector is a narrow, single-integration issue rather than a contradiction of the overall catalog-breadth claim. Missing for 10: independent third-party verification of the full catalog size/quality across many integrations, and broader reliability data beyond one flaky connector report.
